Dear Customer,

Thank you for reaching out about the login issues your account team is experiencing. I sincerely apologize for the disruption this is causing to your team's work and your customers.

We are aware of this issue and our technical team is actively working to resolve it as quickly as possible. We understand the urgency and impact this has on your operations, and we are treating this as a priority matter.

We will keep you updated on our progress and will notify you as soon as the issue is resolved.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

Best regards,
Morgan Lee
